latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release providing comprehensive SMS best practices for Sendly API integration.
- Covers requirements for TCPA compliance, opt-out handling, E.164 phone formatting, and quiet hours enforcement.
- Details message segmentation limits, SHAFT content filtering, credit costs, and error handling.
